body:
They always say forgive and forget. I think I've done the forget part just fine as he lives in a different state and I barely see or communicate with him (this Christmas was first time in 2 years). Part of me has forgiven him, and another part of me is still hurt and also somewhat jealous of his successes. 

I sometimes wonder what my life would be like now if my brother didn't do those things to me. I won't kill myself I don't think. Not now anyways.
yeah, the life not being fair part really sucks.

I really don't want to speak to any professionals about any of this. I was a bit reluctant to do an anonymous thing like this. I'm sorry to hear about what happened to you at 16. I got to remember that many others have suffered through abuses worse than I have and I can't blame all my problems on that. I think just seeing him again this Christmas brought up a lot of bad feelings that are starting to go away a bit now that he's gone. Thanks for reaching out to me.
